snippet.title: Diabolika Tutorial (See the game in action)
snippet.description:
See Diabolika in action and learn the basic rules.

WEBSITE: http://www.diabolika-game.com
BUY IT ON ITUNES: http://itunes.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewSoftware?id=319325183&mt=8

Diabolika was created by Derek Yu and Jon Perry.
Tutorial created by Jon Perry.
All art is by Derek Yu.
First music track is by Jon Perry.
Second music track is by Interrobang (Jon Perry, Ted Kupper, Erik Wahl, Tony Lux).
Devil played by Dave Ross.
